questions.question: The length of the base of a right-angled triangle is 40 cm and its hypotenuse is 41 cm long. What is its area (in cm²) and perimeter (in cm), respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Base of right angled triangle = 40cm

Hypotenuse of right angled triangle = 41cm

**Formula:**

In Right angled triangle,

Using pythagoras theorem,

⇒ hypotenuse² = base² + height²

Area of right angled triangle = 1/2 × base × height

Perimeter of right angled triangle = base + height + hypotenuse

**Calculation:**

In given right angled triangle,

⇒ 41² = 40² + height²

⇒ Height = √81 = 9 cm

Area of right angled triangle = 1/2 × 9 × 40 = 180 sq.cm

Perimeter of right angled triangle = 40 + 9 + 41 = 90 cm

**∴ Area and perimeter of right angled triangle is 180 sq.cm and 90 cm respectively.**

questions.question: A man sells two articles for Rs. 620 each, one at a profit of 24% and the other at a loss of 24%. What is his loss/profit percent in the whole transaction?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SP of each article = Rs.620

Profit % = 24%

Loss % = 24%

**Formula:**

Profit % = (SP - CP)/CP × 100

Loss % =(CP - SP)/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ 24 = (620 - CP)/CP × 100

⇒ CP = Rs.500

Cost price of one article is Rs.500

Then,

⇒ 24 = (CP - 620)/CP × 100

⇒ CP = Rs.815.79

The cost price of the other article is Rs.815.79.

Total cost price of two articles = 500 + 815.79 = Rs.1315.79

Total selling price of two articles = 620 + 620 = Rs.1240

**∴ Overall loss % = (1315.79 - 1240)/1315.79 × 100 = 5.76%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

If the price same, then profit and loss Percent is given then find the directly profit or loss%

x% - y% - xy/100

⇒ 24 - 24 - 24 × 24/100

⇒ - 5.76 

Negative shows the Loss Percent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**If SP is same, Profit and Loss% same, then always result in loss %

⇒ XY/100

⇒ 24 × 24/100 = 5.76% Loss

questions.question: If 7A = 4B = 14C, then what is A: B: C?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

7A = 4B = 14C

**Calculation:**

Let 7A = 4B = 14C = k

A = k/7, B = k/4 and C = k/14

Then,

A : B : C = k/7 : k/4 : k/14

Multiply the above by LCM of 7, 4, and 14 i.e. 28

We get A : B : C = 4k : 7k : 2k

**∴ A : B : C = 4 : 7 : 2**

questions.question: A bicycle wheel has a radius of 42 cm. It makes 40 revolutions in 25 seconds. What is its speed (in km/h, up to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of wheel = 42cm

Number of revolutions = 40

**Formula:**

Speed = Distance/time

Circumference of circle = 2πr

**Calculation:**

Circumference of wheel = 2 × 22/7 × 42 = 264 cm

Total distance in 40 revolutions = 40 × 264 = 10560 cm = 0.1056 km

Total time = 25 seconds = 25/3600 hour

Speed = 0.1056/(25/3600) = 15.2 kmph

**∴ The speed of the bicycle is 15.2 kmph.**

questions.question: P can complete five-eighths of a work in 15 days and Q can complete three-fourths of the same work in 30 days. They worked together for 8 days and then P left. How much time will Q working alone, take to complete the remaining work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P can complete five-eighths of work in = 15 days

Q can complete three-fourths of the same work in = 30 days.

**Calculation:**

P alone can complete work in = 15 × 8/5 = 24 days

Q alone can complete work in = 30 × 4/3 = 40 days

(P + Q)'s 1 day's work = 1/24 + 1/40 = 1/15

(P + Q)'s 8 days work = 8/15

Remaining work after 8 days = 1 - 8/15 = 7/15

Time taken by Q to complete 7/15 of work = 7/15 × 40 = 56/3 days

= 18 days + 2/3 × 24 = 18 days + 16 hours

**∴ The time taken by Q alone to complete the remaining work after 8 days is 18 days and 16 hours.**

questions.question: A kite is flying at the height of 138 m above the ground. It is attached to a string inclined at 45° to the horizontal. What is the approximate length (in m) of the string?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Height at which kite flying = 138m

**Calculation:**

Triangle is formed with the height at which the kite flies as the height of the triangle, the Length of string as one side of the triangle, and the horizontal as the base of the triangle.

The triangle is 45 - 45 - 90 triangle.

⇒ sin 45 = (height at which kite fly)/(Length of string)

⇒ 1/√2 = 138m/length of string

⇒ length of sting = 195.16 ≈ 195m

**∴ The approximate length of the string is 195m.**

questions.question:
Study the given pie-chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie-chart represents the consumption of fuel (in million litres) by various modes of transport of a country X in the year 2015. The total consumption of fuel by various modes of transport of the country is 800 million litres.

(The data shown here is only for mathematical exercise. They do not represent the actual figures of the country.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2994b7942e98ea7a18fdd88a804e2bcb387d8a0ebd15623d09729d5a8dc476dd.png] 

The fuel consumed by light vehicles is approximately what percentage of the combined consumption of fuel for aviation and waterways?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Fuel consumed by light vehicles = (800 × 70/360 × 100) million litres

Total fuel consumed by aviation and waterways = (800 × (90 + 45)/360 × 100) million litres

**∴ Required percentage = (800 × 70/360 × 100)/(800 × 135/360 × 100) × 100 = 51.85 ≈ 52%**

questions.question: If ( x + (2)/(x) ) = 7, then what is the value of ( 2x² + (8)/(x²) ) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

⇒ (x + 2/x) = 7

**Formula:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒(x + 2/x) = 7

Squaring on both sides of the equation, we get

⇒(x + 2/x)2 = 7²

Using the formula: (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

⇒ x2 + 4/x2 + 2 × x × 2/x = 49

⇒x² + 4/x² + 4 = 49

⇒ x² + 4/x² = 49 - 4

⇒ x2 + 4/x2 = 45 

Multiplying by 2 on both sides of the equation, we get

⇒ 2 × (x2 + 4/x²) = 45 × 2

⇒ 2x² + 8/x² = 90

**∴ The value of (2x² + 8/x²) is 90.**

questions.question: If A = 60°, then what is the value of (4cos³ A - 3cos A)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The expression **4cos³ A − 3cos A** is the standard **trigonometric identity** for **cos 3A**.

Given **A = 60°**, the expression becomes **cos (3 × 60°) = cos 180°**.

Since **cos 180° = −1**, the value of the expression is **−1**.

**∴ The correct answer is −1.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Angle **A = 60°**

**Formula Used:** Value of **cos 60° = 1/2**

Substitute **A = 60°** in the expression **4cos³ A − 3cos A**:

⇒ 4 × (cos 60°)³ − 3 × (cos 60°)

⇒ 4 × (1/2)³ − 3 × (1/2)

⇒ 4 × (1/8) − 3/2

⇒ 1/2 − 3/2

⇒ (1 − 3) / 2

⇒ −2 / 2

⇒ −1

**∴ The correct answer is −1.**

**__Additional Information__**

Triple Angle Formulas

cos 3A = 4cos³ A − 3cos A and sin 3A = 3sin A − 4sin³ A.

Values of Cosine

cos 0° = 1, cos 90° = 0, cos 180° = −1, and cos 270° = 0.

Double Angle Formulas

cos 2A = cos² A − sin² A = 2cos² A − 1 = 1 − 2sin² A.</p

questions.question: The perimeter of an isosceles triangle is 91 cm and its base is 1 (1)/(4) times each of its equal sides. What is the length (in cm) of its base?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Perimeter of an isosceles triangle = 91cm

**Formula:**

Perimeter of an isosceles triangle = 2 × equal side + unequal side

**Calculation:**

⇒ Base = 5/4 × equal side

Then,

⇒ 91 = 2 × equal side + 5/4 × equal side

⇒ 13/4 × equal side = 91

⇒ Equal side = 28 cm

⇒ Base = 5/4 × 28 = 35 cm

**∴ Length of base is 35cm.**

questions.question: A man cycles from P to Q, a distance of 30 km, in 2 hours 48 minutes. The road from P is a level road for 18 km and then it is uphill to Q. The man’s average speed on the level road is 15 km/h. What is his average uphill speed (in km/h)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between P and Q = 30km

**Formula:**

Average speed = total distance/total time

**Calculation:**

Time taken by A = 2 hr + 48 min = 2 + 48/60 = 14/5 = 2.8 hours

Distance of level road = 18km

Time taken to travel level road = 18/15 = 1.2 hours

Time taken to travel uphill road = 2.8 - 1.2 = 1.6 hours

Distance of uphill road = 30 - 18 = 12 km

Speed to travel uphill road = 12/1.6 = 7.5 kmph

**∴ Average uphill road speed is 7.5kmph.**

questions.question: A solid metallic right circular cylinder has diameter 32 cm and height 9 cm. It is melted and recast into a solid sphere. What is the radius (in cm) of the sphere?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Volume of Cylinder** = **Volume of Sphere**

πr²h = (4/3)πR³

16 × 16 × 9 = (4/3) × R³

R³ = 16 × 16 × 9 × 3 / 4 = 16 × 4 × 27 = 64 × 27

R = 4 × 3 = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of **Cylinder** (d) = 32 cm ⇒ Radius (r) = 16 cm

Height of **Cylinder** (h) = 9 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of **Cylinder** = πr²h

Volume of **Sphere** = (4/3)πR³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67ae6e0c6e355b15d7cd45312b98d04e630067da5dcdf12754ce45980001ce74.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of **Cylinder** = Volume of **Sphere**

⇒ π × (16)² × 9 = (4/3) × π × R³

⇒ 256 × 9 = (4/3) × R³

⇒ R³ = (256 × 9 × 3) / 4

⇒ R³ = 64 × 27

⇒ R = ³√(64 × 27)

⇒ R = 4 × 3 = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Cylinder Properties

Total Surface Area of **Cylinder** = 2πr(h + r) and Curved Surface Area = 2πrh.

Sphere Properties

Surface Area of **Sphere** = 4πR². For a **Hemisphere**, Volume = (2/3)πR³ and Total Surface Area = 3πR².

Recasting Rule

When one solid is **melted** and **recast** into another, the **Volume** remains constant, provided there is no wastage.</p

questions.question: In how many years, will 5,450 amount to 8,175, if invested at simple interest at the rate of 12.5% per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

R = 12.5 % per annum

**Formula:**

Let P = Principal, R = Rate of interest and N = Time

SI = PNR/100

**Calculation:**

SI = Final Amount - Initial Amount= 8175 - 5450 = Rs.2725

So SI= Rs. 2725

Since SI = PNR/100

⇒ 2725 = 5450 × 12.5 × N/100

⇒ N = 4

**∴ It will take 4 years.**

questions.question:

(take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:

Diameter of wheel = 1.33m

**Formula:**

Circumference of wheel = 2πr = πd

**Calculation:**

Distance covered in one revolution = π × 1.33 = 1.33π m

**∴ Distance covered in 380 revolutions = 22/7 × 1.33 × 380 = 1588.4 ≈ 1588**
